global_silver_linings.snippet: When you see these photos from the Toronto Zoo of their newest resident, you’ll know why we had to share. A pregnant pygmy Hippopotamus gave birth a week ago—tiny feet appearing after 1.5 hours of active labor. The calf began teetering around in an attempt to stand within 15 minutes of birth—and was seen confidently […] The post Toronto Zoo Celebrates Birth of Endangered Pygmy Hippo – The Pictures and Video are Adorable appeared first on Good News Network .
global_silver_linings.reason: The birth of a pygmy hippo at Toronto Zoo is a genuine win for one of the world's rarest large mammals, with fewer than 2,500 remaining in the wild. Every healthy arrival strengthens the case for dedicated breeding programmes and keeps hope alive for the species' future.

garden_note.note: Late summer settles over Zürich with that particular golden heaviness — the dahlias are reaching their full baroque splendour and the air still holds warmth long after the Limmat has gone quiet. Savour the dusk tonight; the evenings are already noticeably shorter than they were a month ago, and every one is worth lingering in.
